QuestInfo.name: Francois's Delivery
QuestInfo.0: Since you did #p1032002# a favor, he's going to fill you in about the #t4000031#. Listen to #p1032002#'s story.
QuestInfo.1: As #p1032002# told his story, he dropped an invoice on the ground. He needs to tell the customer that he lost it, so take the #b#t4033007##k to #b#p1040004##k.
QuestInfo.2: You took the #t4033007# that #p1032002# lost, and brought it to #p1040004#. What kind of invoice is it?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 2,500 Can proceed to the Eliminate Malady quest

0.0: I did not make the dolls themselves, but I was involved with the nails that went in them. If you want to know more, there's information on this #t4033007#, and...let's just pretend I lost it yesterday.\r\n#b(He drops the invoice on the floor.)#k
0.1: All you need to do is deliver this #t4033007# to #p1040004#. My clients take their privacy VERY seriously, so if anyone asks, you found this invoice and had no idea what it meant. Deal?

yes.0: So, I lost the #b#t4033007##k, and you randomly found it, right? Okay then. While you're at it say hello to #b#p1040004##k for me.

no.0: The information you want is on this invoice. This is your chance.

1.0: What took you so long? Did #p1032002# answer your questions?

yes.0: So, it's the nails, not the doll... And this invoice... I better examine this.

npc.0: You forgot where #b#p1040004##k is already? He's at the #b#m101040000##k. Maybe you should be writing these things down.

item.0: Wait, he gave you a #b#t4033007##k, and you lost it on the way back? Geez, you're terrible at this! Well, go back to #b#p1032002##k and ask for another one!
